topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The corridors seem longer now, the walls a little too close. It's strange, really, how the light seems to dim a bit, even as I move from one door to another. The photographs on the walls, once so familiar, now whisper different stories. I linger at the doorway, the new department buzzing with a rhythm that’s both new and unsettling. Faces turn, curious, as if they too can sense the weight of this shift. It’s a new space, filled with the promise of what lies ahead, yet the steps to reach it feel heavier than they should. I place my things on the new desk, the surface cool and untouched, and I wonder how long it will take to make it feel like a part of me.
